request.subject: UNIT:CANDY:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Turn it into a candy submarine: remove the mast, the wafer sail and the pennant; the hull becomes one closed fat eclair-shaped hull of the same dark chocolate #5a3423 with a thick stripe of pale pink frosting #ffb8d8 along its top; on top a round pink gumdrop conning tower with a pink and white striped candy-cane periscope; two round pale mint candy portholes; a swirl lollipop at the stern. Nothing red. Keep the size, waterline, thick black outline and style, with nothing under the hull.
